description: A complete architectural overhaul introducing a high-performance modular system. By leveraging a TypeScript-driven core, near-instantaneous metadata fetching and seamless navigation across multi-season libraries are achieved, regardless of scale.

logs.desc: Implemented a High-Performance Season Switcher for both Info and Watch pages, supporting complex multi-season structures.
New 'listAnime.ts' core engine: Handles all anime listings, season redirects, and dynamic video button generation with TypeScript-driven efficiency.
Fail-Safe Metadata such as 'Unknown Uploader' and 'Unknown Studio' fallbacks to prevent UI breakage when metadata is missing.
Navigation Arrows: Introduced 'Previous' and 'Next' buttons to content listers for streamlined browsing.
Enhanced Timestamps: Extended precision to include hours and seconds on information pages.
Integrated Turkish localization support for the footer component.
Applied [BETA] tags to Discover and Featured pages to indicate ongoing performance optimizations.
Resolved incorrect routing issues within the footer's company links.
Refactored 'gridVideoButton': Episode numbers are now persistent; durations are hidden on small screens; descriptions are hover-triggered for a cleaner UI.
Redesigned video player control buttons and Anime Card architecture for a more premium, modern aesthetic.
Script Optimization: 'infoHandler.ts' and 'playlistHandler.ts' now leverage the new modular logic for significantly faster execution.
Full Footer Redesign: Updated layout to be 100% responsive across all device tiers.
Disabled automatic collapsing on the Update Log page to improve readability and scannability.
Cleaned up the navbar by removing redundant text from the settings link for a minimalist look.
The 'Go To' navigation functionality on the 'What's New' page is currently unresponsive.
